entities.label: PETITIONER

sentences.text:
It has been categorically stated in the aforesaid communication that acquisition proceedings shall be completed at the earliest possible in compliance of the mandate of the judgment alleged to .
have been violated.

Since, steps already stand taken for acquisition of land in terms of mandate of the judgment alleged to have been violated, therefore, nothing remains to be adjudicated in the instant proceedings and the same are closed.
However, liberty is reserved to the petitioner to get the same revived in case, acquisition proceedings are not taken to its logical end within a period of six months.
Pending miscellaneous applications, if any, also stand disposed of.

(Sandeep Sharma) Judge 21st June, 2023 (Guleria)
